propositions: Destructive repair must acquire and hold provider-neutral durable pause ownership before mutation, enforcing fail-closed abort if git identity is missing, pre-existing pause exists, or CAS write fails.
Destructive repair must read reconciler lock in-flight and abort on any held, corrupt, timeout, transport, or authentication state before proceeding to mutation.
Destructive repair cleanup must reread pause document and OID as one snapshot, comparing reason to invocation token, and delete only via the observed OID without retrying on CAS miss.
Missing or changed pause during cleanup is an error; cleanup failure leaves durable pause for operator recovery and does not recreate or clear another actor's pause.
fsck --repair and doctor --repair share the same repair-owned pause contract and operate without requiring GitHub CLI workflow disable/enable.
Legacy read_pause callers remain compatible by delegating to read_pause_with_oid and discarding only the OID.
